Headline: #6 Jackson Park Express Temporary Reroute near Balbo/Columbus
ShortDescription: #6 Jackson Park Express buses are temporarily rerouted due to street blockage near Balbo/Columbus.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#6 Jackson Park Express buses are temporarily rerouted due to street blockage near Balbo/Columbus.

Southbound buses will operate via State, Balbo, Michigan, Roosevelt, and Lake South Shore then resume their normal route.

Northbound buses will operate via Lake South Shore, Roosevelt, and Michigan then resume their normal route.

Allow extra travel time.
